title: Settings
themeHint: System follows your operating system's appearance.
autoRefreshHint: How often to poll the repository. Git operations (commit, checkout, stash) are picked up instantly; edits to files are noticed on the next poll — with Off, only on manual refresh.

identity.title: Commit author
identity.hint: The name and email git records on every commit. Stored in your global git config, so the command line uses it too.
identity.name: Name
identity.overrideHint: For example a work email for this repository only. Saved in its .git/config.
identity.missing: No author set: git will refuse to commit.

diff.wrapHint: Long lines break onto the next row instead of scrolling sideways.
diff.ignoreWhitespaceHint: Hides changes that only touch spaces and indentation. Staging single hunks is off while this is on.
